Name: JP's Better Item Stack
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][i][u]Better Item Stacks[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]


[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Did you want a challenge where you could only have one item per stack? Or maybe you just wanted to have exactly 1,000 units in a stack? Whatever you wanted, you've got it now. [/size][/color][/i][/font][/b]


[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Georgia]A simple mod that lets you change the number of items you can have in a stack. Highly customizable via GMCM.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Georgia]You can also stack furniture and other items that you couldn't stack before.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#ffffff][font=Georgia]Left Shift + Right-click to select the number of objects to take from a stack, create items or food and buy items. [/font][/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

[b][color=#00ff00][size=5][font=Georgia][i]There's not much more to say, it's compatible with mobile devices, and always remember GMCM.[/i][/font][/size][/color][/b]


[b][font=Georgia][i][u][color=#ffff00][size=5]Translations[/size][/color][/u][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission.[/color][/size]
[size=4]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.[/size]
[size=4]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there. [/size]
